NOTE
**Still not ready — requested commit message and screenshot fixes aren't there**

New: The author pushed once and said the changes are done, but the commit messages and the PR description look unchanged, and the code size is the same. Missing: the commit messages still need "Fixes a part of" removed and "Fixes: #16094" added to the last commit, after the description. The screenshots are still the full-width ones, not precise before/after crops.

###### Next step

"not ready" stays; no reviewer to assign yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! The commit messages and screenshots don't look changed yet. Please remove "Fixes a part of" from the commits, put "Fixes: #16094" after the description in the last one ([commit discipline](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/version-control.html#commit-messages)), and crop the screenshots to just the changed text ([precise before/after screenshots](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots)).
```
